import math

chrono.SetChronoDataPath(chrono.GetChronoDataPath())
veh.SetDataPath(chrono.GetChronoDataPath() + 'vehicle/')

initRot = chrono.ChQuaterniond(1, 0, 0, 0)

# Visualization type for vehicle parts (PRIMITIVES, MESH, or NONE)
vis_type = veh.VisualizationType_MESH

# Collision type for chassis (PRIMITIVES, MESH, or NONE)
chassis_collision_type = veh.CollisionType_NONE

# Type of tire model (RIGID, TMEASY)
tire_model = veh.TireModelType_TMEASY

terrainWidth = 100.0   # size in Y direction

# Contact method

contact_vis = False

# Simulation step sizes
step_size = 1e-3
tire_step_size = step_size

# Time interval between two render frames
render_step_size = 1.0 / 50  # FPS = 50


# Create the UAZBUS vehicle, set parameters, and initialize

vehicle.SetContactMethod(contact_method)
vehicle.SetChassisCollisionType(chassis_collision_type)
vehicle.SetChassisFixed(False)
vehicle.SetInitPosition(chrono.ChCoordsysd(initLoc, initRot))
vehicle.SetTireType(tire_model)
vehicle.SetTireStepSize(tire_step_size)


vehicle.Initialize()

vehicle.SetChassisVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle.SetSuspensionVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle.SetSteeringVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle.SetWheelVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle.SetTireVisualizationType(vis_type)

vehicle.GetSystem().SetCollisionSystemType(chrono.ChCollisionSystem.Type_BULLET)

# Create the terrain
patch_mat = chrono.ChContactMaterialNSC()
patch_mat.SetFriction(0.9)
patch_mat.SetRestitution(0.01)
terrain = veh.RigidTerrain(vehicle.GetSystem())
patch = terrain.AddPatch(patch_mat, 
    chrono.ChCoordsysd(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0), chrono.QUNIT), 
    terrainLength, terrainWidth)

patch.SetTexture(veh.GetDataFile("terrain/textures/tile4.jpg"), 200, 200)

vis.SetWindowSize(1280, 1024)
vis.SetChaseCamera(trackPoint, 6.0, 0.5)

vis.AddLightDirectional()
vis.AddSkyBox()

throttle_time = 1.0  # time to go from 0 to +1
braking_time = 0.3   # time to go from 0 to +1
driver.SetSteeringDelta(render_step_size / steering_time)
driver.SetThrottleDelta(render_step_size / throttle_time)
driver.SetBrakingDelta(render_step_size / braking_time)

driver.Initialize()

# output vehicle mass
print( "VEHICLE MASS: ",  vehicle.GetVehicle().GetMass())

# Number of simulation steps between miscellaneous events
render_steps = math.ceil(render_step_size / step_size)

# Initialize simulation frame counter s
realtime_timer = chrono.ChRealtimeStepTimer()
step_number = 0
render_frame = 0

while vis.Run() :
    time = vehicle.GetSystem().GetChTime()
    # Render scene and output POV-Ray data
    if (step_number % render_steps == 0) :
        vis.BeginScene()
        vis.Render()
        vis.EndScene()
        render_frame += 1

    # Get driver inputs
    driver_inputs = driver.GetInputs()

    # Update modules (process inputs from other modules)
    driver.Synchronize(time)
    terrain.Synchronize(time)
    vehicle.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs, terrain)
    vis.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs)

    # Advance simulation for one timestep for all modules
    driver.Advance(step_size)
    terrain.Advance(step_size)
    vehicle.Advance(step_size)
    vis.Advance(step_size)

    # Increment frame number
    step_number += 1
    # Spin in place for real time to catch up
    realtime_timer.Spin(step_size)

# PyChrono UAZBUS Vehicle Simulation with Terrain and Driver System

Below is a complete PyChrono simulation script that implements a UAZBUS vehicle on rigid terrain with a driver system and real-time visualization:

```python
import pychrono as chrono
import pychrono.irrlicht as chronoirr
import pychrono.vehicle as veh
import pychrono.vehicle.uaz as uaz

# =============================================================================
# Simulation parameters
# =============================================================================

# Simulation step size
step_size = 1e-3

# Simulation end time
tend = 10

# Point on chassis tracked by the camera
trackPoint = chrono.ChVectorD(0.0, 0.0, 1.75)

# =============================================================================
# Create the simulation system and add items
# =============================================================================

# Create the vehicle system
vehicle = uaz.UAZBUS()
vehicle.SetContactMethod(chrono.ChContactMethod_NSC)
vehicle.SetChassisFixed(False)
vehicle.SetInitPosition(chrono.ChCoorD(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 0.6), chrono.ChQuaternionD(1, 0, 0, 0)))
vehicle.SetInitFwdVel(10)
vehicle.Initialize()

# Create the terrain
terrain = veh.Terrain(vehicle.GetSystem())
terrain.SetContactFrictionCoefficient(0.8)
terrain.SetContactRestitutionCoefficient(0.1)
terrain.SetContactMaterialProperties(2e7, 0.3)
terrain.SetPlotType(veh.Terrain::PLOT_NONE)
terrain.Initialize()

# Create the driver system
driver = veh.ChDriver()
driver.SetSteeringDelta(0.02)
driver.SetThrottleDelta(0.02)
driver.SetSteeringGain(0.8)
driver.SetSpeedGain(0.2)
driver.SetThrottleGain(0.6)
driver.SetBrakingGain(0.4)
driver.Initialize()

# =============================================================================
# Create the visualization system
# =============================================================================

# Create the vehicle Irrlicht interface
vis = veh.ChVehicleVisualSystemIrrlicht()
vis.SetWindowTitle("UAZBUS Simulation")
vis.SetWindowSize(1280, 720)
vis.SetChaseCamera(trackPoint, 6.0, 0.5)
vis.Initialize()
vis.AddTypicalLogo()
vis.AddTypicalSky()
vis.AddTypicalLights(vehicle.GetSystem())
vis.AddTypicalGrid(20, 20, 0, 0, chrono.ChColor(1, 1, 1))
vis.AttachVehicle(vehicle.GetVehicle())

# =============================================================================
# Simulation loop
# =============================================================================

# Initialize simulation frame counter and simulation time
frame = 0
time = 0

while vis.Run() and time < tend:
    # Update time
    time = vehicle.GetSystem().GetChTime()

    # Driver inputs
    driver.Synchronize(time)
    driver.SetSteering(0.5 * chrono.Cos(0.5 * time))
    driver.SetThrottle(0.4)
    driver.SetBraking(0.0)

    # Update vehicle state
    vehicle.Synchronize(time, driver.GetSteering(), driver.GetThrottle(), driver.GetBraking())

    # Update visualization
    vis.Synchronize(time, driver.GetSteering(), driver.GetThrottle(), driver.GetBraking())
    vis.Render()

    # Advance simulation for one timestep
    vehicle.Advance(step_size)

    # Increment frame number
    frame += 1

# Cleanup
vis.Close()
```

## Explanation of the Implementation:

1. **Initialization**:
   - We import necessary PyChrono modules including the core library, Irrlicht visualization, and vehicle components
   - Set simulation parameters including step size, end time, and camera tracking point

2. **Vehicle Setup**:
   - Create a UAZBUS vehicle instance with NSC (Non-Smooth Contact) method
   - Set initial position (0,0,0.6) and forward velocity (10 m/s)
   - Initialize the vehicle system

3. **Terrain Configuration**:
   - Create a rigid terrain with specified friction (0.8) and restitution (0.1) coefficients
   - Set material properties (stiffness and damping)

4. **Driver System**:
   - Initialize a driver system with control parameters (steering/throttle gains and deltas)
   - The driver will provide time-varying steering input (cosine function)

5. **Visualization**:
   - Set up Irrlicht visualization with window size, camera settings, and lighting
   - Add typical visualization elements (logo, sky, grid)
   - Attach the vehicle to the visualization system

6. **Simulation Loop**:
   - Runs until either the visualization window is closed or simulation time reaches tend
   - Synchronizes driver inputs, vehicle state, and visualization at each timestep
   - Advances the simulation by step_size at each iteration

7. **Cleanup**:
   - Properly closes the visualization window when simulation ends

patch.SetTexture(veh.GetDataFile("terrain/textures/concrete.jpg"), 200, 200)  # Changed from tile4.jpg to concrete.jpg

# Create the vehicle Irrlicht interface
vis = veh.ChWheeledVehicleVisualSystemIrrlicht()

vis.AddLightDirectional()
vis.AddSkyBox()
vis.AttachVehicle(vehicle.GetVehicle())

# Create the driver system
driver = veh.ChInteractiveDriverIRR(vis)

# Set the time response for steering and throttle keyboard inputs.
steering_time = 1.0  # time to go from 0 to +1 (or from 0 to -1)
throttle_time = 1.0  # time to go from 0 to +1

driver.SetBrakingDelta(render_step_size / braking_time)

# output vehicle mass

    # Render scene and output POV-Ray data
    if (step_number % render_steps == 0):
        vis.BeginScene()
        vis.Render()
        vis.EndScene()
        render_frame += 1

    # Double lane change maneuver logic - ADDED
    if time < lane_change_start_time:
        # Initial straight driving
        driver_inputs = driver.GetInputs()
    elif time < lane_change_start_time + lane_change_duration:
        # First lane change (left)
        driver_inputs = driver.GetInputs()
        driver_inputs.m_steering = 0.5  # Steer left
        driver_inputs.m_throttle = 0.6  # Moderate acceleration
    elif time < second_lane_change_time:
        # Straight after first lane change
        driver_inputs = driver.GetInputs()
        driver_inputs.m_steering = 0.0  # Straight
    elif time < second_lane_change_time + lane_change_duration:
        # Second lane change (right)
        driver_inputs = driver.GetInputs()
        driver_inputs.m_steering = -0.5  # Steer right
    elif time < braking_start_time:
        # Straight after second lane change
        driver_inputs = driver.GetInputs()
        driver_inputs.m_steering = 0.0  # Straight
    elif time < braking_start_time + braking_duration:

        driver_inputs = driver.GetInputs()
        driver_inputs.m_steering = 0.0  # Straight
        driver_inputs.m_throttle = 0.0  # No throttle
        driver_inputs.m_braking = 0.8   # Apply brakes
    else:

        driver_inputs.m_steering = 0.0  # Straight
        driver_inputs.m_throttle = 0.0  # No throttle
        driver_inputs.m_braking = 0.0   # No braking

    driver.Synchronize(time)
    terrain.Synchronize(time)
    vehicle.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs, terrain)
    vis.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs)

    # Advance simulation for one timestep for all modules
    driver.Advance(step_size)
    terrain.Advance(step_size)
    vehicle.Advance(step_size)
    vis.Advance(step_size)

    # Increment frame number
    step_number += 1
    # Spin in place for real time to catch up
    realtime_timer.Spin(step_size)
